warm_season_reference.title: U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976
warm_season_reference.table: layer base values (geopotential 71 km and 84.852 km), as geometric heights
warm_season_reference.basis: The 74210.3 m mass height lies between the standard atmosphere's 71 km and 84.852 km geopotential layer bases (71802 m and 86000 m geometric). Log-pressure interpolation gives 2.65 Pa; the lower bracket supplies a 3.9564 Pa bound. A standard atmosphere is not a seasonal envelope, which is why the measured maximum is carried beside it; both are more than a thousand times lower in pressure than the 5000 Pa default model top.
